text: {"findings":[{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Required ETA/promise guardrails absent","detail":"The proposal widens promise windows but lists only Cost Per Delivery as a guardrail. Delivery CSAT, Contact Rate, and Promise Accuracy are all required for promise changes and none are present.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":["guardrail-standards#eta-and-delivery-promise-changes"],"recommendation":"Add Delivery CSAT, Contact Rate, and Promise Accuracy as guardrails with stop thresholds. Also track checkout conversion, given EXP-014."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Customer-level randomization, 1-week duration, no MDE/power","detail":"Randomizing by customer leaks effects across the shared supply pool for promise changes. A 1-week run is under the 14-day minimum, and no MDE, power, sample size, or stopping rule is recorded.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by customer. Run for 1 week. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference","experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality","experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Use a geo, market, or switchback design. Run at least 14 days, or get Data Science sign-off for a shorter test. Pre-register the primary metric, MDE, power, and stopping rule."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-014 without applying its learning","detail":"The proposal says it follows EXP-014 but ignores the result. EXP-014 showed the OTD gain came from relaxed promises and cost conversion (-1.2%), and it said to judge on Promise Accuracy and conversion, not OTD alone. The proposal uses OTD as its sole success metric.","evidence_quote":"Follows EXP-014, but only applies during storms rather than permanently.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Cite EXP-014's results and learning. Add Promise Accuracy and checkout conversion as evaluation metrics, and explain why storm-only widening will avoid the conversion loss."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Baseline and problem claim lack a source","detail":"The 78% storm OTD baseline is stated as fact with no source. The problem statement cites a generic 'LMD weather impact analysis' with no specific reference or figures.","evidence_quote":"baseline 78%, target 88% within 8 weeks","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the data source and query or date range for the 78% baseline, and link the weather impact analysis."}]}
